backup_waiver_reaffirmed.user_words_summary: Backup would take ~10h on this machine; most meaningful products are on GitHub; local data is mostly evidence/history/rebuildable env. No raw-data backup. On accidental loss, recover what git can recover.
backup_waiver_reaffirmed.consequence: U0 exit item '不可替代资产拥有可读可恢复副本' = USER-WAIVED (not satisfied by evidence). U3 deletion does not wait for an external copy. Near-zero-cost mitigation kept: before deleting any branch/worktree that holds local-only commits, those refs are captured in a local git bundle (seconds, KB-MB) — a git-object safety net against our own cleanup mistakes, not a raw-data backup; uncommitted non-evidence edits are listed per path in the delete list.
